title: pm-eng 1:1 prep - Arianna Morris
content:
Goal for this 1:1
- Quick sync on priorities for next 2 sprints across API, Console, Dedicated, Private.
- Surface any infra/latency blockers that could impact SLA for Dedicated customers.
- Align on rollout plan for console feature flags and automated fallbacks.
- Confirm owners + near-term action items.

Context / recent updates (for Miguel)
- Hosted API: small perf regression reported for short-chat workloads (p95 latency + ~20ms last week). Investigations suggest a change in batching heuristics + new kernel selection defaults; ticket API-4721 open.
- Console: feature flags for per-route observability rolled into staging; UX feedback from PM beta indicates we should reorder token-cost column.
- Dedicated: two onboarding customers running into cold-start variance on certain seq lengths; likely model compile/kernels mismatch for quantized variants.
- Private: enterprise pilot kicked off; need to confirm KMS integration checklist and audit log retention for GDPR customer.

Agenda items
1) Latency regression triage (15m)
   - Status of root cause for p95 regression on short-chat paths.
   - Hypothesis: batching change + kernel selection priority; can we revert or tweak heuristics?
   - Ask Miguel: estimate for fix + risk of rollback for current release.

2) Dedicated customer cold-starts (10m)
   - Share logs (I attached sample) showing higher variance at seq len 512 vs 256.
   - Is there a short-term mitigation (pin kernel/disable quantization for these models) and a medium-term plan (compiler heuristics)?

3) Console rollout & observability UX (10m)
   - Plan for reorder of columns and exposing per-route SLOs in default dashboard.
   - Quick decision: expose token-cost as default column? I think yes for engineering/infra teams.

4) Private deployment checklist (5m)
   - Confirm KMS/HSM integration steps + owner for audit log retention policy.
   - Any infra blockers for on-prem packaging for next pilot?

Open questions I want to raise
- Is the current batching heuristic change (recent PR) worth a full rollback or can we tune parameters to trade slightly higher throughput for restored p95?
- For Dedicated: do we want to expose a setting to customers to prefer stable kernel selection at the cost of throughput? (short-term flag)
- For Console: should cost columns be per-token or per-request for mixed workloads?

Metrics to check before 1:1 (I will bring these)
- Hosted API: p50/p95/p99 latency for short-chat (<128 tokens) and medium-chat (128-512) over last 7 days.
- Dedicated: cold-start variance by sequence length for the two impacted customers.
- Console: adoption metrics for the new observability beta (number of orgs, most-used dashboards).

Proposed decisions needed during the 1:1
- Approve rollback vs parameter tweak for batching heuristic.
- Approve short-term mitigation for Dedicated cold-starts (flag to pin kernel/disable quantization).
- Confirm default Console column changes (token-cost visible by default).
- Assign owner for KMS integration + audit retention (suggest: Priya leads KMS, infra to own audit retention).

Draft action items (I'll capture formally in ticket updates after the 1:1)
- Miguel: share RCA doc for p95 regression + perf histogram by sequence length (due EOD Fri).
- Engineering (Miguel + infra): prototype kernel pinning flag and test impact on throughput vs latency (due next Wed).
- Priya: update Console staging to show token-cost as default and share a quick screenshot for feedback (due Tue).
- Product (me): notify Dedicated pilot customers of planned mitigation and schedule short maintenance window if rollback required (due Thu).
- Security/Infra: confirm KMS integration owner and draft audit retention policy for Private pilot (due next Wed).

Notes to self / talking points
- Emphasize that rollback is a last resort but we need fast mitigation to preserve SLA for paid Dedicated customers.
- Ask Miguel if there's a quick config toggle we can expose to Dedicated customers who prioritize stability.
- Offer to help prioritize tickets & coordinate PR review to speed up any fix.

Attachments I will bring to the meeting (links pasted in linked_artifacts):
- perf histograms + flame graphs (short-chat vs medium-chat)
- sample Dedicated cold-start logs
- console UX screenshots from staging

Follow-up format after meeting (how I'll log updates)
- Update API-4721 with RCA + chosen remediation (rollback vs tuning) + owner + ETA.
- Create a small RFC for kernel pinning flag (if we decide to pursue) and link to Dedicated onboarding docs.
- Post short note in #platform-ops with summary & customer impact statement for CS to share.

Backlog items to consider (not urgent)
- Longer-term: automated test harness for kernel/compiler selection across seq length distribution to catch regressions pre-release.
- Longer-term: expose per-model compile profile in Console to help customers reason about cold-start behavior.

Quick list of people to include for follow-ups
- Miguel Torres (eng lead, serving-runtime)
simple_text_preview: 1:1 prep notes for Arianna Morris w/ Miguel Torres: agenda (latency regression, dedicated cold-starts, console rollout, private deploy checklist), metrics to bring, proposed decisions + action items
